verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses at evening on Mount Sinai.
verses.2: You commanded the children of Israel, and they gave the Levites cities from their possession. They also gave them fields around those cities to be used by the Levites.
verses.3: And their cities shall be places for them to dwell in. And from their ruins, they will have homes for themselves, as well as places for storing their possessions and for all their needs.
verses.4: And from the edges of the cities, which you gave to the Levites, from the walls of the city and its surroundings, a distance of one thousand meters.
verses.5: And their borders extend beyond the city of Et-Paat-Kedma for a distance of one thousand miles; and Et-Paat-Negab for another one thousand miles. And Et-Paat-Yam also for one thousand miles. And Et-Paat-Tsafon for one thousand miles. And this city will become their suburbs.
verses.6: And those cities that you gave to the Levites—those six cities of the inheritance that you gave to Nuns Shama, the murderer. And on those cities, you gave forty and twelve cities in total.
verses.7: All the cities that you give to the Levites shall be forty in number; along with their suburbs.
verses.8: And the cities that you will give as inheritance to the children of Israel, from among those who are numerous and strong, each person will receive according to his share. The cities that they inherit will be given to the Levites.
verses.9: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.10: I spoke to the children of Israel and said to them, “You are crossing over the Jordan River into the land of Canaan.”
verses.11: And they gave you cities that could be destroyed. It will become a place of destruction for you. And there will be a murderer who will take your lives in vain.
verses.12: And may you have cities where you can take refuge from the murderer. May the murderer not die until he stands before the judgment seat.
verses.13: And the cities that will be given to us will be six cities of refuge.
verses.14: These three cities shall be given to the Jordan River. And these three cities shall be given to the land of Canaan. They will become important cities.
verses.15: To the children of Israel, and to their rulers and leaders: these six cities shall serve as a refuge for us. May all those who sin in ignorance be punished accordingly.
verses.16: And if it’s made of iron, then they will strike it, and it will die. The murderer will also die.
verses.17: And if a stone on which the murderer died is struck, then the murderer will also die. That is, the murderer’s death follows the death of the murderer himself.
verses.18: Or in a tree that has died; those who struck it died as well. The murderer also died. It’s the death of the murderer.
verses.19: The one who pours blood will kill the murderer. By hitting him with that blood, he will kill us too.
verses.20: And if, out of hatred, they were driven away or placed on the side of the enemy, then they would die.
verses.21: Or in anger, he struck him with his hand, and the murderer died. He killed the murderer by hitting him with his hand.
verses.22: And if, suddenly, without any cause, it is destroyed or scattered upon it all its contents, without any reason at all.
verses.23: Or on every tree that has died there, without any sight of it. It falls upon itself and dies. And it does not cause harm to itself, nor seeks to bring harm upon itself.
verses.24: And the jury judged between the one who stabbed and the one who shed blood, regarding these judgments.
verses.25: And the council saved the murderer from the hands of the blood-thirsty man. They brought him back to the city where he was taken captive. There, he remained until the death of the high priest, who had been killed by the holy oil.
verses.26: And if the murderer were to go and destroy the borders of a city that has been taken by force, then he would be punished accordingly.
verses.27: And he found the murderer outside the borders of the city. The murderer was killed by the murderer himself. He didn’t have any blood to spare.
verses.28: For in the city of Miklat, the great priest will sit until his death. After the death of the great priest, the murderer will return to his own land.
verses.29: And let these be for you a rule of judgment in all your circumstances.
verses.30: Everyone who kills a person will be killed by the witnesses. No one who is a witness to such a murder will live to see it happen again.
verses.31: And do not take any life for the sake of a murderer who is evil and deserves to die. For death is death.
verses.32: And they shall not take a priest from our tribe to go to the city of Miklat, so that he may return and dwell in the land until his death.
verses.33: And they shall not make the land they are in it fertile again. For blood makes the land unfruitful; and the land cannot be made fertile again by the blood that has been spilled there. For it is in the blood that the land becomes barren.
verses.34: And you shall not defile the land where you live. I, the LORD, dwell within it among the children of Israel.
